CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to any identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified with coordinates, its origin/status is stated, and organizational/presentation information (coordinate orientation/pattern) is given for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim linking attention to a content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report names specific contents ('red','blue') with explicit coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origins/ provenance metadata are stated separately from the content coordinates, distinguishing content identity from its status/source.

O.rationale: The text specifies how contents are presented/organized (coordinate orientation and explicit multi-coordinate patterns).
